751-1115-4289.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

7084-7885-8227.easyPrerequisites:
Down in the Valley's second chapter ability has resolved.
You control a land.
7084-7885-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7885-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf creature token
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

533-5934-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
533-5934-7839.notablePrerequisites: There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
533-5934-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to The Rollercrusher Ride.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-6441-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating six 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Ojer Taq and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1270-6441-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 7^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 42 after the first iteration, 294 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

1339-2122-4050-7704.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-4050-7704.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1032-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
1032-6500.description:
Activate Tephraderm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Tephraderm triggers, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2539-3094-4659-5434-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-5434-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

240-4785-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

677-4217-5211-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
677-4217-5211-5256.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lutri.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Lutri from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
677-4217-5211-5256.notes: You can start the combo instead at step 7 if Lutri is in your graveyard. This changes the mana needed to {6}{W}{U}{B}{R}{R}{G}.

751-2060-5943.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
751-2060-5943.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
751-2060-5943.notes: You can repeat this combo until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2113-5051-5078-5741.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-969-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2366-3430-5702-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-5702-6791.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

413-5220-6539-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
When Willow Geist enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1987-4423-4823-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4423-4823-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

1329-1750-2793-5226-5261.description:
Activate Lithatog's first ability by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2092-2734-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
2092-2734-4131.description:
Cast Cyberdrive Awakener by paying {5}{U}.
When Cyberdrive Awakener enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each noncreature artifact you control to become a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

198-1651-2645-4131.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
198-1651-2645-4131.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Basalt Monolith, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.

1558-2963-3731-4840.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating an Etherium Cell artifact token.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Myrs and Etherium Cell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1124-2034-2696-3650.notablePrerequisites: Elspeth's Talent attached to another planeswalker you control.
1124-2034-2696-3650.description:
Activate the planeswalker with Elspeth's Talent attached by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil and up to other other creature and/or land you control, and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

643-876-4302-4881-4951.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least four.
643-876-4302-4881-4951.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Priest of Fell Rites.
Activate Priest of Fell Rites by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it.
When Priest of Fell Rites dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve the Priest of Fell Rites ability, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Priest of Fell Rites.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Activated Sleeper.
Activate Activated Sleeper by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it.
 When Activated Sleeper dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve the Activated Sleeper ability, returning Priest of Fell Rites from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Repeat.

567-2034-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain one life.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2-1057-1308-4659.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Brimaz's first ability triggers, creating two Incubator artifact tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the two Incubators, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

152-1872-2557.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate both Composite Golem tokens by sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1636-3000-4170-4802.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
A creature you control has a counter on it.
1636-3000-4170-4802.description:
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a counter from a creature you control, creating a Treasure artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure and Squirrel tokens, you may activate Fain's other abilities.

1808-2034-5267.description:
Activate the Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Eloise's and Ulvenwald Mysteries' second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Eloise trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Ulvenwald Mysteries trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Clue ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Human Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Eloise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve Eloise's first trigger, causing you to investigate.
 Resolve Eloise's second trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

2034-3558-4535-5224.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds.
Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crookshank Kobolds.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Crookshank Kobolds dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand.
Repeat.

1295-1463-2199-3406.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet's ability an arbitrarily large number of times.
Draw cards from Zndrsplt's trigger upon successful coinflips until there are no cards in your library.
In response to Frenetic Efreet's next activation on the stack, cast Red Elemental Blast targeting Zndrsplt.
The rest of Frenetic Efreet's activations do nothing to the boardstate and can be skipped.
Cast Thassa's Oracle.

2334-2556-3617.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat

867-4090.notablePrerequisites:
Jackal Pup has indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Jackal Pup.
867-4090.description:
Deal damage to Jackal Pup.
Jackal Pup triggers, attempting to deal damage to you, but dealing damage to Jackal Pup instead due to Pariah.
Repeat step 2 in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.
